newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA STOCKS DRIFT LOWER, RAND SUPPORTS GOLDS.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA STOCKS DRIFT LOWER, RAND SUPPORTS GOLDS.

text.p: 1004 GMT - South African shares drifting around day's lows on weaker rand, which falls to fresh six-month lows on U.S. dollar, and softer bond. Few market features bar Spicer-Mitchell which off 26 pct after profit warning. Gold shares just firmer as rand props up ailing randgold price.

* Dealers say market digesting recent slew of economic data and facing quiet week on economic front. Stocks need some consolidation after recent highs on hopes for interest rate cut soon, which now fairly much discounted.
* Turnover until noon low at just over 200 million rand. Rand last at 4.6540 bid from 4.6320/6350 late on Friday on short-covering, speculative offshore dollar demand.
* Spicer-Mitchell sheds eight cents to new year low of 22 cents after says half year results will be hardhit by tough market conditions. Parent Cityhold sheds 13 pct to 26 cents.
* Chemical stock Sentrachem suspended pending company announcement expected in local newspapers on Tuesday.
* Industrial index off 26.0 points to 9,119.5, gold index adds 4.4 to 968.2 and all-share index off 3.3 to 7,453.5.
